mapper.sql: from basket_member_account acc left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = acc.id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset af on af.id = mp.avatar_file_id and af.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.member_id = acc.id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team ct on ct.id = p.current_team_id and ct.is_delete = 0 left join ( select g.player_id, max(g.id) as grant_id from basket_captain_grant g inner join basket_player_profile pp on pp.id = g.player_id and pp.is_delete = 0 where g.is_delete = 0 and g.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and pp.certification_status = 3 and (g.valid_from is null or g.valid_from <= now()) and (g.valid_to is null or g.valid_to >= now()) and (g.team_id is null or g.active_unique_key is not null) group by g.player_id ) captain on captain.player_id = p.id left join basket_captain_grant cg_active on cg_active.id = captain.grant_id and cg_active.is_delete = 0 left join basket_season cg_season on cg_season.id = cg_active.season_id and cg_season.is_delete = 0 left join basket_series cg_series on cg_series.id = cg_season.series_id and cg_series.is_delete = 0

where acc.is_delete = 0 and acc.id = #{memberId} and acc.email like concat('%', #{email}, '%') and mp.nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') and p.player_no like concat('%', #{playerNo}, '%') and p.game_terminal = #{gameTerminal} and acc.account_status = #{accountStatus}
and ( p.game_account like concat('%', #{gameId}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from basket_player_platform_account pa where pa.player_id = p.id and pa.is_delete = 0 and (pa.display_game_id like concat('%', #{gameId}, '%') or pa.normalized_game_id like concat('%', lower(trim(#{gameId})), '%')) ) )
and acc.account_status in #{s}
and p.certification_status = #{certificationStatus} and p.player_status = #{playerStatus} and p.current_team_id is not null and (p.id is null or p.current_team_id is null) and ct.team_name like concat('%', #{currentTeamName}, '%') and captain.grant_id is not null and (p.id is null or captain.grant_id is null)
and p.id is null and p.certification_status = 3
and p.certification_status != 3 and exists ( select 1 from basket_player_cert_application ca where ca.member_id = acc.id and ca.is_delete = 0 and ca.application_status in (1, 2) )
and p.certification_status != 3 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_player_cert_application ca where ca.member_id = acc.id and ca.is_delete = 0 and ca.application_status in (1, 2) ) and exists ( select 1 from basket_player_cert_application ca where ca.member_id = acc.id and ca.is_delete = 0 and ca.application_status = 4 )
and p.id is not null and p.certification_status != 3 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_player_cert_application ca where ca.member_id = acc.id and ca.is_delete = 0 and ca.application_status in (1, 2, 4) )
mapper.select: select id, account_no, username, email, account_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_member_account where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select id, account_no, username, email, account_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_member_account where is_delete = 0 and id in #{id}

select acc.id as memberId, acc.account_no as accountNo, acc.username as username, acc.email as email, mp.nickname as nickname, IFNULL(af.access_url, 'https://basketball-1453992653.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/basketball/public/2026/08/01/b1f4d9a28beb48beb90fed28439e8e4a.png') as avatarUrl, acc.email_verified as emailVerified, p.id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, p.certification_status as certificationStatus, p.player_status as playerStatus, acc.account_status as accountStatus, p.certified_time as certifiedTime, acc.create_time as createTime, acc.last_login_time as lastLoginTime, p.current_team_id as currentTeamId, ct.team_name as currentTeamName, case when captain.grant_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as hasCaptainQual, coalesce(nullif(trim(cg_season.display_title), ''), cg_series.series_name) as activeCaptainGrantEventName, ( select ca.application_status from basket_player_cert_application ca where ca.member_id = acc.id and ca.is_delete = 0 order by ca.create_time desc limit 1 ) as latestApplicationStatus
order by acc.create_time desc

select acc.id as memberId, acc.account_no as accountNo, acc.username as username, acc.email as email, acc.email_verified as emailVerified, acc.account_status as accountStatus, acc.last_login_time as lastLoginTime, acc.last_login_ip as lastLoginIp, acc.create_time as accountCreateTime, acc.update_time as accountUpdateTime, mp.nickname as nickname, IFNULL(af.access_url, 'https://basketball-1453992653.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/basketball/public/2026/08/01/b1f4d9a28beb48beb90fed28439e8e4a.png') as avatarUrl, mp.gender as gender, mp.profile_status as profileStatus, p.id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, p.game_terminal as gameTerminal, p.game_account as gameAccount, p.game_nickname as gameNickname, p.position_code as positionCode, p.certification_status as certificationStatus, p.player_status as playerStatus, p.certified_time as certifiedTime, p.current_team_id as currentTeamId, ct.team_name as currentTeamName from basket_member_account acc left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = acc.id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset af on af.id = mp.avatar_file_id and af.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.member_id = acc.id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team ct on ct.id = p.current_team_id and ct.is_delete = 0 where acc.id = #{memberId} and acc.is_delete = 0
